windows.aggregation: Rates are medians of four process means per arm per cell. Paired changes are geometric means of the two round ratios, each ratio using geometric means of that round: two test and two reference process means; private layout is compared with candidate. All samples retained.
interpretation_limits: Each process reports a mean and SD over five timed iterations; per-iteration raw timings are not exposed.
System disk activity includes this benchmark model loading. A disk flag is not proof of unrelated work.
Sampled process counters can miss short-lived processes and leave inaccessible or newly seen processes unknown.
GPU engine maxima are not additive; benchmark and monitor PIDs are separated from unrelated activity.
One same-file layout perturbation does not bound all code layout effects.
This compares the activation repair with main on Windows CPU/Radeon; reference-runtime floors belong to the phase final gate. No MI50 timing is claimed.

windows_plan.scope: Final activation range, precise Q8 vector and F32 row registry repair versus clean main; Windows CPU/Radeon. Matched clean detached builds. Reference-runtime phase floor remains separate.
windows_plan.control: Private candidate-based control appends an unused global function to vulkan_backend.cpp. Shader modules must match candidate byte for byte. Measures one same-file host layout perturbation only; linker may remove it, so it is not a universal noise bound. Never merge.
windows_plan.monitor: Same stdlib Windows PDH and per-process monitor at one-second intervals, before and throughout every measured arm. Report inaccessible/new processes and unavailable counters as unknown.
windows_plan.retention: All 48 planned calls retained, including flagged activity and slow calls; four process means per arm/cell, five iterations per phase; two symmetric blocks. No competing owned tests, builds or downloads during measurement.
windows_plan.interpretation: Report gains, losses, both block ratios and layout control together. This is a correctness fix: unresolved cost or a material slowdown requires investigation; no per-case cutoff replaces the project tradeoff assessment.
